organization.name: RA2 Tech
organization.summary: Described in the proposal as RA2 TECH SA, Montreux, Switzerland. The Everything website describes Everything as a DeFi protocol where swap, lend, borrow and leverage share one pool. The company description, size and R&D spend come from the proposal only.

claims.claim: Public property packs cover token standards: crytic/properties and a16z/erc4626-tests.
claims.method: GitHub API: both repositories are public (AGPL-3.0, last pushes 2026-03-09 and 2025-07-29). The statement that they do not cover pool and market economics was not tested.

claims.claim: Euler lost about $197 million in March 2023.
claims.method: Page text states a $197 million loss from the Euler flash loan attack, published March 15, 2023.

claims.claim: Cream lost about $130 million in October 2021.
claims.method: Page text states a loss of $130m in available liquidity on October 27, 2021.

claims.claim: A pack of 37 properties is built, MIT licensed, with fuzz campaigns and mutant tests passing.
claims.method: The proposal links no repository for the pack. A GitHub repository search for the team and pack terms found no match. Property counts and test results were not checked.

claims.claim: RA2 TECH SA employs 25+ engineers and has self-funded more than $20 million of R&D.
claims.method: The website does not state these figures. The Swiss commercial register search page needs JavaScript and was not readable.

claims.claim: The two founders' backgrounds (ethical hacking, EPFL mathematics) as listed in the proposal.
claims.method: The LinkedIn profiles linked in the proposal return HTTP 999 to automated requests and were not read.
